# BeepeeLabs

> Bakare Oluwaferanmi (BeepeeLabs) — frontend developer, digital marketer, and content strategist based in Lagos, Nigeria.

BeepeeLabs offers software engineering, technical writing, and SEO strategy services, available for remote work worldwide.

## Background
- B.Eng. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Olabisi Onabanjo University
- Builds performant, lightweight web products — from single-file HTML apps to full React/Vite builds
- Works with Firebase, Supabase, Cloudinary, and AI APIs
